description: Full-featured event scheduler with month, week, day, agenda, and timeline views. Supports client-side event lists or server-side data providers, drag-and-drop event moving, resource grouping, context menus, and custom event templates. Timed events render as tinted cards with a coloured left stripe; all-day events keep a solid fill. The toolbar groups are navigation, title, views, an opt-in add button and a More menu that holds Print. The title opens a date popover. Keyboard: the month grid, time grid and timeline use one roving tab stop (arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown), events and slots activate on Enter and Space exactly once, and Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key opens the context menu on the cell itself. The toolbar view switcher is a local tablist (aria-selected, one tab stop) and the title heading is a polite live region.

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: Client-side event list. Alternative to DataProvider.

parameters.name: DataProvider
parameters.description: Server-side data provider. Takes priority over Events if both are set.

parameters.name: WorkItemSource
parameters.description: Unified work-item source shared with other components (Gantt, Notion). When set (and no DataProvider is given), scheduled work items overlapping the visible range are loaded and shown as calendar events, and drag/resize changes are persisted back through it (when the provider declares the Update capability).

parameters.name: View
parameters.description: Active view type.

parameters.name: ViewChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the view type changes.

parameters.name: CurrentDate
parameters.description: Currently displayed date (determines visible range).

parameters.name: CurrentDateChanged
parameters.description: Fires when navigation changes the date.

parameters.name: SelectedDate
parameters.description: Currently selected date.

parameters.name: SelectedDateChanged
parameters.description: Fires when a day is selected. A day click selects the day and does not navigate.

parameters.name: SelectedEvent
parameters.description: The selected event, matched by Id. The matching event carries aria-current=true (it is a button, so aria-selected is not allowed) and a --selected class. A day or slot click selects the day and does not clear this.

parameters.name: SelectedEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects an event.

parameters.name: Views
parameters.description: Views the toolbar switcher offers, in the given order. Null offers every view. A View that is not offered is inserted at its canonical position.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: When false, the toolbar row — which is this component's header — is not rendered.

parameters.name: OnAddClick
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks the add button. The button renders only when a delegate is bound.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Host content rendered before the navigation group.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Host content rendered after the view switcher, before the overflow menu.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

parameters.name: OnSlotClick
parameters.description: Fires when an empty time slot is clicked.

parameters.name: OnEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires after an event is moved or resized via drag and drop.

parameters.name: OnSlotContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on an empty time slot.

parameters.name: OnEventContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on an event.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: Resources for grouping (timeline/resource views).

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: First day of the week (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, ..., 6 = Saturday). Default: 1 (Monday). Drives the month grid, the week range and the week title together; values outside 0-6 wrap.

parameters.name: WorkDayStart
parameters.description: Work day start time.

parameters.name: WorkDayEnd
parameters.description: Work day end time. With ShowFullDay false it is the last rendered minute.

parameters.name: WeekDays
parameters.description: Which days the week renders. WorkWeek keeps the first five; the title and the data load use the same range.

parameters.name: MonthWeeks
parameters.description: How many weeks the month grid renders. Auto drops an empty trailing week, so a month that fits renders 35 days.

parameters.name: ScrollToTime
parameters.description: When set, Day, Week and Timeline scroll this time into view after the first render. Null does not scroll.

parameters.name: ShowFullDay
parameters.description: When false, Day, Week and Timeline render only the working hours. Default true, the full day.

parameters.name: HighlightOffHours
parameters.description: When true, hours outside the working day are tinted. Default false, so a full-day grid stays uniform.

parameters.name: ShowNowIndicator
parameters.description: When true, today's column draws the current-time indicator. Default true; set false to restore the previous look.

parameters.name: ResourceHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Replaces the default resource header (initials avatar, name and resource type) in the time grid and the timeline.

parameters.name: ShowEventResource
parameters.description: When true, a timed event in the time grid names its resource under the title.

parameters.name: SlotDuration
parameters.description: Slot duration in minutes for day/week views.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether events are read-only (no drag/resize).

parameters.name: HideTimeGrid
parameters.description: When true, hides the hourly time grid body in Day and Week views (only column headers and all-day row are shown).

parameters.name: ShowAdjacentMonthEvents
parameters.description: When true, events are rendered in adjacent-month day cells visible in the month grid. Default: true.

parameters.name: EventTemplate
parameters.description: Custom event template. Replaces the inner content of an event in every view (month, day, week, agenda, timeline); the positioning wrapper and resize handles stay.

parameters.name: AgendaDays
parameters.description: Number of days the Agenda view loads, renders and navigates by. Default: 30.

parameters.name: MaxVisibleEvents
parameters.description: Maximum events shown in a month day cell before "+N more". Default: 3.

parameters.name: OnMoreClick
parameters.description: Fires when the "+N more" button of a month day cell is activated, with that day's date. Without a delegate the scheduler opens that day in the Day view, but only when the host binds both @bind-View and @bind-CurrentDate; with either binding missing the click is inert.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es).

parameters.name: AllowPrint
parameters.description: Whether the toolbar shows a Print button (uses the browser print dialog with print CSS). Default: true.

parameters.name: HighlightWeekends
parameters.description: When true, Saturday and Sunday cells (month) and columns (day/week) get tm-scheduler-month-day--weekend / tm-scheduler-timegrid-col--weekend. Default false, so an existing host keeps the unmarked grid.

parameters.name: AllDayEventStyle
parameters.description: Paint of an all-day event. Solid (the default) keeps the historical solid fill. Tinted adds tm-scheduler-event--tinted and uses the shared tinted surface with --tm-text-primary.

parameters.name: TimeZoneId
parameters.description: Display timezone (IANA id such as Europe/Prague, or a Windows id). When set, event times are converted to this zone at the render boundary (DST-aware). When null, the machine-local timezone is used and non-recurring events are passed through unchanged for backward compatibility.

cssVariables.name: --event-color
cssVariables.description: The event's own colour, set inline from TmScheduleEvent.Color. A missing colour falls back to --tm-color-primary for the tint and the stripe, and to --tm-scheduler-event-bg for a solid all-day fill.

cssVariables.name: --event-text-color
cssVariables.description: Text colour on a solid event fill. Set inline to --tm-scheduler-event-fg-on-light when white text would fall below 4.5:1 on the consumer colour; otherwise the theme's --tm-scheduler-event-fg.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-event-bg
cssVariables.description: Solid fill of an all-day event that sets no colour. Defaults to --tm-color-primary-600.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-event-fg
cssVariables.description: Text on a solid event fill. Defaults to white.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-event-fg-on-light
cssVariables.description: Text on a light consumer colour. Black in both themes.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-weekend-bg
cssVariables.description: Wash of a weekend cell or column when HighlightWeekends is true. A mix of --tm-bg-muted.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-event-tint
cssVariables.description: Amount of the event colour mixed into the shared surface. 14%.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-event-border-tint
cssVariables.description: Amount of the event colour mixed into the shared surface border. 28%.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-event-bar-width
cssVariables.description: Width of the shared surface left bar. Defaults to --tm-space-1.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-hour-height
cssVariables.description: Height of one hour in the time grid. Defaults to 3rem.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-visible-hours
cssVariables.description: Read-only. The component sets it to the visible range in hours, and the geometry reads it.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-offhours-bg
cssVariables.description: Wash of a slot outside working hours when HighlightOffHours is true. A 6% mix of --tm-text-secondary.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-lane-height
cssVariables.description: Height of one timeline lane. Defaults to 3.5rem.

cssVariables.name: --tm-scheduler-timeline-hour-width
cssVariables.description: Width of one timeline hour. Defaults to 5rem.

usedAbstractions.name: IScheduleDataProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Data provider for calendar events and resources

examples.title: Basic month view with static events
examples.code: <TmScheduler Events="@_events" View="TmScheduleViewType.Month" CurrentDate="DateTime.Today" CurrentDateChanged="@(d => _currentDate = d)" OnEventClick="@HandleEventClick" />

examples.title: Week view with server-side data provider and resources
examples.code: <TmScheduler DataProvider="@_dataProvider" View="TmScheduleViewType.Week" Resources="@_resources" SlotDuration="30" FirstDayOfWeek="1" OnSlotClick="@HandleNewEvent" OnEventChanged="@HandleEventMoved" />

examples.title: Month view with custom event template
examples.code: @evt.Title @evt.Description
